coaching.headline: We won six fights and cashed zero of them — they won eight, cashed two, and three of our fight wins (16, 16.8 and 20.1) were traded for a Fangtooth across the map.
coaching.team: The middle of this game was won and thrown away at once: at 16, 16.8 and 20.1 we took the fight and they took Fangtooth cross-map — three straight trades, none of our six fight wins converted — while six of our seven solo catches went to Yin, five of them on the midlaner. Gideon's 79k magical was the late bill for that tempo: the 21.8 fight was opened a body down and cost Fangtooth, and the 35.3 0-2 at their Primal pit was taken while both winning lanes stayed home. Winning the bodies means nothing while the pit goes unguarded; the objective ledger closed 29 takes to 14.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Three times — 16, 16.8 and 20.1 — the team won the fight while Fangtooth fell to them across the map; those trades, not the fights, are where the game left.

perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Cuban Noobster's GRIM.exe won the carry read and then some — 14/5 with 57253 hero damage and Gideon dead to him five times. The flags are about where that damage stood: alive and ahead at 12.6, 26.1 and 35.3 while short-handed fights were lost; a fed carry at the objective ends this game, a fed carry in lane only farms it.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim's Phase poured out 22985 healing with 19 wards, holding a support matchup read 'theirs all game'. Six deaths is the cost line — the falls at 21.8 and 37.9 both came in fights opened a body down, fights better declined.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs' Serath produced the highlight — the solo 3-0 at their Fangtooth at 16.8 — and the problem: 11 deaths with no armor into a three-physical comp. The dive-reset loop kept generating kills, but every reset that ended in a death fed a 17/3 Yin, and the 35.3 fall directly priced out their second Primal Fangtooth.
